D.t: Debbie Dingell leads by 42.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 156,914 votes; a one point swing is about 1,870 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +34.1 and D +49.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
